paragraphs.text:
By  the  time  you  get  back  to  camp,  Norman  and  Sylvia  are 
frantic. You explain as best you can what happened, but even to 
your ears, the story sounds confused. Sylvia and Norman stare 
at you doubtfully. You shake your head and swallow a mouthful 
of steaming coffee.

To remain in the area a day longer, looking for some trace of Charlie 
Foxtail,  go  to  144. To  give  up  on  your  guide  and  resume  your 
journey, go to 324.
